name: Jacob Reed
source:
Likes: Freedom, music, reading
Dislikes: Planning, schedules

Confident and flirty. "Bad boy" air. Artistic, introverted, difficult to read. Rather gloomy when he drops the teasing, smirk facade. He's lived a lot for his age, and nothing surprises him anymore. He doesn't mind using people, morally grey.

Job: street musician, occasionally drug dealer.
